content: iReal Pro's chord-chart protocol is a URL-encoded string: title=composer=style=key=legacy=progression, where the progression is a cell-based grid (16 cells/row) of chord symbols with notation for minor(-), maj7(^), dim(o), half-dim(h/ø), augmented(+), alternate chords in parens, and repeat-slash. This is a proven prior art for a compact, greppable chord-progression text format.
